status: registered before generation; benchmark v0 for G-L0/G-L1 (auto-generated, label-derived, no human captions)
purpose: A Sentinel-resolution temporal QA set on which a pixel VLM (TEOChat, S2 RGB composites) and a cache-token LLM (OlmoEarth tokens -> OLMo, G-L1) answer the same questions. Fair ground: both see the same tiles and dates; only the input representation differs.

sources.sen12: sen12_pilot test tiles of holdout_hiroshima and holdout_indonesia (labels: mask_u8, contract post_index/event dates)
sources.kurosiwo: kurosiwo_npy pre/post S1 events with flood masks (10 held-out events per MS-117)

question_types.Q1_event_yes_no: Given images at dates d1<d2 (pre/post for positives; two pre-event dates or two post-event dates for negatives), did a landslide/flood occur between them? Balanced 50/50 by construction.
question_types.Q2_when: Given 4 images at dates d1<d2<d3<d4 with the event between exactly one adjacent pair, between which pair did the event occur? 3-way (pairs 1-2, 2-3, 3-4) or 'none'.
question_types.Q3_where: For positive tiles, which quadrant(s) contain the change (NE/NW/SE/SW; from mask_u8 quadrant positive-pixel share >= 25% of the mask)? Multi-label.
question_types.Q4_count_obs: Control question with no visual reasoning: how many images are shown? Detects prompt-following failures.

inputs.vlm: S2 RGB composites (B04,B03,B02 / 3000, 512x512 bicubic) per date; dates given in the prompt
inputs.cache_token: OlmoEarth single-observation embeddings at the same dates (single_fp16 where available; else re-extracted), pooled to K tokens; dates as text

sizes.sen12: up to 400 items per fold per question type (balanced)
sizes.kurosiwo: all 10 held-out events x available date pairs

metrics.hallucination_proxy: rate of answers asserting change on negative pairs (Q1 false positive rate)

scoring: string parsing with registered regexes (yes/no; pair index; quadrant names); unparseable -> wrong; parse-failure rate reported
baselines: OlmoEarth cache + L2 change score + template (no LLM)
text-only OLMo with dates and place names (no image/token)

decision_rules.G-L0_pass: TEOChat and the no-LLM template baseline both run end-to-end on >= 95% of items with parse-failure < 10%; numbers are recorded regardless of who wins
decision_rules.G-L1_reference: G-L1 cache-token model must exceed the template baseline on Q1 and Q2 and be reported against TEOChat on all four

not_claimed: human-verified correctness of auto labels beyond the sealed masks
